about.description: BOT is an exchange traded fund perpetual listed on Crypto.com, tracking RoboStrategy, Inc., margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 1h. Up to 50× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
